project_type: Python monorepo — FastAPI backend + Streamlit frontend + ML/agent pipeline
build_system: pip + requirements.txt; no build step required beyond pip install. pathlib.Path used for all file I/O for Windows/Linux portability.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio; tests live in tests/; run with: pytest tests/ -v --tb=short
verification_instructions: 1) Run `python data/synthetic_generator.py` to generate CSVs. 2) Run `pytest tests/ -v --tb=short` — all 4 test files must pass. 3) Run `python -c "from api.main import app"` to confirm import-safe API. 4) Run `python -c "import app.app"` to confirm import-safe Streamlit app. 5) Run `docker compose config` to validate Docker Compose YAML.
snapshot_or_generated_files: data/sample_claims.csv and data/sample_policies.csv are generated by `python data/synthetic_generator.py` — must be run before tests. data/models/ directory receives .pkl files at first model train. data/chroma_db/ receives ChromaDB persistence on first vector store init.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell workspace (c:\Users\Sumedh\projects\claimguard-ai). All paths must use pathlib.Path — never hardcoded Unix slashes. Do NOT start uvicorn or streamlit servers — import-only verification only. GROQ_API_KEY not set in dev; rule-based fallback must work. DATABASE_URL not set; CSV fallback must work. ENCRYPTION_KEY not set; auto-generate and save to data/.encryption_key.
contribution_requirements: All Pydantic models use v2 syntax (model_config, field_validator). python-dotenv loads .env at startup in api/main.py. No hardcoded secrets. Every optional dep wrapped in try/except with graceful fallback. Commit each FEAT separately with conventional commit message.
key_patterns: Graceful fallback pattern: try: import foo; HAS_FOO=True; except ImportError: HAS_FOO=False. Then in methods: if not HAS_FOO: return []. Model save/load via pickle to data/models/. Pydantic v2 models use `model_config = ConfigDict(...)` not class Config. All models include `timestamp: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)`. RBAC dependency: `Depends(require_role(['analyst','admin']))`. Rate limit: `Depends(rate_limit_dependency)`. LangGraph StateGraph built in a factory function, not at module level (avoids import-time crash if langgraph missing).
directory_structure: claimguard-ai/ — project root with requirements.txt, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, README.md | src/ — all Python domain modules (underwriting, claims_fraud, graph_collusion, shap_utils, vector_store, agent_graph, hitl, copilot_metrics, compliance_irdai, encryption, rbac, rate_limit, database) | api/ — FastAPI app (main.py) | app/ — Streamlit app (app.py) | data/ — synthetic CSVs + policy docs + models + chroma_db | eval/ — ragas_eval.py | tests/ — pytest test files | .github/workflows/ — ci.yml | .agents/tasks/ — plan artifacts (not committed to app code)
